title: Argentinian Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Argentina, made with chicken, potatoes, and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the potatoes, beef broth, and chicken. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
